gen-dafont-azonix-gf-krub: Krub reads tall and friendly, its tall-set lowercase carrying each line with curves left slightly unfinished. Azonix ahead of it is wide, crisp and commanding, and holds up when shrunk.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-kufam: Neon-tube lines and wide stance. Azonix sets the commanding tone with its stencil-like width, while Kufam keeps every curve open and lets its heavy lowercase bodies fill the line.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-lexend: Big, friendly lowercase with open curves. Lexend carries the reading feel, with strokes that hold their thickness around every bend, while Azonix stays wide and commanding above it.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca draws a plain, unshaded line with terminals that stop short of curling back, and its lowercase looms large. Azonix adds the commanding wide capitals on top.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-liter: Azonix has capitals barely taller than its lowercase, which makes its wide, authoritative words take a moment to knit together. Yet Liter, sans-serif with no stroke contrast and tall lowercase, gives the eye somewhere easy to land.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-mada: Mada reads approachable and modern, with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close all the way. Make Azonix small and its stencil-cut letters lose their command.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-martel-sans: Modern and generous, Martel Sans opens every curve and holds a high mean line across its words. And Azonix above it brings stencil-straight, commanding letters with no brush-style swell anywhere.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-matangi: Matangi has strokes like twine pressed flat, rounded letters left open, and a hefty lowercase. But Azonix, wide and commanding, still gives the pair its strongest voice.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-maven-pro: Wide, commanding capitals up top, then a gentle, high-waisted lowercase below. Maven Pro keeps an open gap in the c and a gentle line thickness, while Azonix is the one built to be noticed.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-michroma: Azonix forms each glyph from a ribbon of constant width, and it feels authoritative. Michroma, sans-serif with a tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascenders, gives every letter a wide berth beneath.
